title: 第一卷 第7章 卖鱼强第一卷 第8章 地下世界的新王
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧
content_zh:
;;
连地下女王都死在这位青年的手里。
这人简直就是恶魔！
“你闯大祸了！主上背后的势力一定不会放过你的！”
白杜鹃反应过来，对着叶青云大叫道。
叶青云向前一跨，就来到白杜鹃的面前，将后者拎起来，冷声道。
“周若烟背后的势力是谁？”
“呵呵，很快你就会来陪我的。”
白杜鹃说完这句话，口鼻溢血，当场身死。
“竟然自杀了，对自己的主子倒是忠心耿耿。”
叶青云说完，把白杜鹃的尸体丢在地上。
白杜鹃也死了……
不少人看见这一幕，遍体生寒，脚底直冒冷气。
唰！
一道黑色人影化作一道残影冲向叶青云。
她手持一把匕首，狠狠地对叶青云的胸膛刺去！
叶青云伸出手，相当精准的抓住这黑影的脖子。
一发力，咔嚓，捏碎了这人的喉骨。
叶青云随意的把这人的尸体丢在地上。
众人一看，心猛地一跳。

这人是周若烟手下的四朵金花之一的乌龙！
乌龙的实力可是达到了七星武者。
在这江宁市的地下世界，仅比周若烟弱一筹！
而且乌龙擅长偷袭之道。
即便如此，她依旧当着众人的面，被叶青云轻易给杀了。
众人对叶青云的恐惧加深几分。
周若烟手下的另外两朵金花一品红和竹桃看见地上的两位姐妹的尸体，心中满是悲戚。
她们俩对视一眼，点点头。
然后，同时服下早已备好的毒药，口鼻溢血，当场死亡。
以她们和周若烟的关系，叶青云肯定不会放过她们的。
现在自己主动自杀，还能避免被人折磨。
周若烟和其手下四位悍将的尸体横七竖八地倒在地上。
这一幕看得不少周围众人心中直冒冷气！
一位中年男人脑子活络，眼疾手快地跪在叶青云的面前。
“这位大人，正所谓国不可一日无主。
现在‘黑玫瑰’已经死在你的手下。
这江宁市的地下之王的宝座理应就由你来坐！
我‘卖鱼强’愿奉你新的地下之王！”
这卖鱼强在这地下世界算是仅次于黑玫瑰的人物。
现在他如此干脆地跪下表示诚心。

可见他对叶青云实力的认可。
有着卖鱼强的率先表态，又有大片人跪在叶青云面前，大声喊道。
content_en:
;;
Even the underground queen died in the hands of this young man.
This man is simply a devil!
"You have caused a big trouble! The forces behind the Lord will definitely not let you go!"
Bai Dujuan reacted and shouted to Ye Qingyun.
Ye Qingyun stepped forward and came to Bai Dujuan, picked up the latter and said coldly.
"Who is the power behind Zhou Ruoyan?"
"Haha, you will come to accompany me soon."
After Bai Dujuan said this, his mouth and nose bled, and he died on the spot.
"He actually committed suicide. He was very loyal to his master."
After Ye Qingyun finished speaking, he threw Bai Dujuan's body on the ground.
The white cuckoo is also dead...
Many people felt chills all over their bodies when they saw this scene, with cold air rising from the soles of their feet.
Uh-huh!
A black figure turned into an afterimage and rushed towards Ye Qingyun.
She held a dagger and stabbed Ye Qingyun in the chest!
Ye Qingyun stretched out his hand and grabbed the black figure's neck quite accurately.
With one force, there was a click, crushing the man's throat bone.
Ye Qingyun casually threw the man's body on the ground.
When everyone saw it, their hearts skipped a beat.
This person is Oolong, one of the four golden flowers under Zhou Ruoyan!
Oolong's strength has reached that of a seven-star warrior.
In the underground world of Jiangning City, he is only weaker than Zhou Ruoyan!
And Oolong is good at sneak attacks.
Even so, she was still easily killed by Ye Qingyun in front of everyone.
Everyone's fear of Ye Qingyun deepened.
Zhou Ruoyan's other two golden flowers, Poinsettia and Bamboo Tao, saw the bodies of the two sisters on the ground, and their hearts were filled with sadness.
They both looked at each other and nodded.
Then, he took the prepared poison at the same time, bleeding from his mouth and nose, and died on the spot.
Based on their relationship with Zhou Ruoyan, Ye Qingyun will definitely not let them go.
Now that I take the initiative to commit suicide, I can avoid being tortured.
The corpses of Zhou Ruoyan and his four warriors lay scattered on the ground.
This scene made many people around them feel chilled!
A middle-aged man with a quick mind and quick eyesight knelt in front of Ye Qingyun.
"My lord, as the saying goes, a country cannot be without its owner for a day.
Now 'Black Rose' has died in your hands.
You should sit on the throne of the underground king of Jiangning City!
I, 'Maiyuqiang', am willing to serve you as the new underground king! "
This fish seller is second only to Black Rose in the underground world.
Now he knelt down so simply to show his sincerity.
This shows his recognition of Ye Qingyun's strength.
The fish salesman was the first to take a stand, and a large number of people knelt in front of Ye Qingyun and shouted loudly.
